title: OSCORE spec gap: C client sends outer code FETCH (0.05) for every OSCORE request
description:
SPEC: RFC 8613 §4.2 (normative, adopted by spec/06-security.md §8.8 'OSCORE (RFC 8613)'): 'With one exception (see Section 4.1.3.5), the Outer Code SHALL be set to 0.02 (POST) for requests'; only messages carrying the Observe option MUST use 0.05 (FETCH).

IMPL: lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_client.c:604-610 — for every OSCORE-protected request (regardless of Observe), client_req.method is overridden to COAP_METHOD_FETCH, with comment 'For OSCORE requests, outer code is always FETCH (0.05) per RFC 8613.' The inner (encrypted) method is correct; only the outer code is wrong.

OBSERVED: every C-originated OSCORE request (GET/POST/DELETE alike) travels with outer code 0.05 FETCH instead of 0.02 POST.

IMPACT: SHALL violation. Compliant receivers discard the outer code (§8.2 step 1) so decryption is unaffected; residual impact is conformance and OSCORE-aware proxy semantics (FETCH vs POST cacheability, RFC 8613 §10). No cryptographic impact.

FIX: set outer method to COAP_METHOD_POST for non-Observe OSCORE requests; use FETCH only when an Observe option is present (and then the request also needs Inner+Outer Observe handling, which the C client currently lacks). Correct the comment.
